# remove-markdown 0.7.1

This patch release fixes HTML tag preservation and adds TypeScript editor documentation for the function and its options.

## Fixes

- `htmlTagsToSkip` now preserves selected tags that have attributes, such as `<code class="language-js">`.
- Tag names are matched at the intended boundary: selecting `code` no longer incorrectly preserves `<codes>`.
- The fix is included in both CommonJS and the portable ESM entry point.

These changes resolve [#127](https://github.com/zuchka/remove-markdown/issues/127) through [#128](https://github.com/zuchka/remove-markdown/pull/128).

## Documentation

- Added editor hover documentation for the function and all nine options in both TypeScript declaration files ([#129](https://github.com/zuchka/remove-markdown/pull/129)).
- Clarified that `separateLinksAndTexts` takes precedence over `replaceLinksWithURL` for inline links only when the separator is non-empty.
- Updated the browser and Deno usage examples to 0.7.1.

## Maintenance

- Updated the development dependency `js-yaml` from 4.3.1 to 4.3.2 ([#125](https://github.com/zuchka/remove-markdown/pull/125)).

There are no API or type signature changes and no new runtime dependencies.

Thanks to [@endlacer](https://github.com/endlacer) for reporting the HTML issue and contributing both the fix and the TypeScript documentation.

```sh
npm install remove-markdown@0.7.1
```

[Full changelog](https://github.com/zuchka/remove-markdown/compare/0.7.0...0.7.1)
